Class Order

java.lang.Object
boba.shop.model.Order
public class Order extends Object
Represents an order in the Boba Shop system. Each order contains details such as the date, time, total amount, payment method, order status, customer ID, and item information.

  • Constructor Details

    • Order

      public Order(LocalDate orderDate, LocalTime orderTime, double totalAmount, String paymentMethod, String orderStatus, int customerId, String itemLink, String customId)
      Constructs a new Order with all relevant details.
      Parameters:
      orderDate - the date when the order was placed
      orderTime - the time when the order was placed
      totalAmount - the total amount of the order
      paymentMethod - the payment method used (e.g., "Cash", "Card")
      orderStatus - the current status of the order (e.g., "Pending", "Completed")
      customerId - the ID of the customer who placed the order
      itemLink - a reference or link to the ordered item details
      customId - a unique identifier assigned to the order
